agent_municipality_snapshot.PrefectureId: Recipient prefecture business ID. Retain this ID AND PrefectureName in every municipality ranking table, even if the user only asks for municipality codes.
agent_municipality_snapshot.DonationCoun: Count over ALL static-snapshot donations, not a JST-calendar-year subset. Count ties use MunicipalityId.
agent_municipality_snapshot.AmountYen: Total yen over ALL static-snapshot donations. The label 2025 seed does not filter dates.
agent_municipality_snapshot.RegisteredMu: Full registered municipality population for this prefecture, independent of TOP/sample and DonationCount. Required for count-plus-sample questions. Read once or MAX; never SUM.
agent_supplier_catalog.GiftId: Catalog gift join key. To answer a specific DonationId's suppliers, first read agent_donation_detail.GiftId and filter/join THIS column. The absence of DonationId here does not mean the catalog link is unavailable.
agent_donation_detail.DonationDateJst: JST calendar date. Filter only for an explicitly requested calendar interval, NEVER just because the user says 2025 seed; that snapshot includes a JST year-boundary spill.
agent_donation_detail.DonationYearMonthJ: JST calendar month. Used for explicit calendar grouping/filtering, not to restrict the whole 2025 seed snapshot.
agent_donation_detail.DonatedAtUtc: UTC donation event timestamp. A snapshot year label alone does not request a predicate on this column.
agent_donation_detail.ResidentPrefecture: Donor residence geography, for '在住者からの寄附'. Independent of recipient geography.
agent_donation_detail.RecipientPrefectur: Recipient municipality geography, for '自治体が受け取った寄附'. Independent of donor residence.
agent_supplier_catalog.SupplierType: Source-owned supplier business type. Include together with supplier ID/name and prefecture ID/name in catalog answers.
agent_supplier_catalog.PrefectureId: Supplier prefecture ID. Retain it with PrefectureName even for a catalog-count/sample question.
agent_supplier_catalog.CatalogGiftCount: Complete distinct gift count for the supplier before TOP/sample filtering. Do not recount sample rows.
agent_donor_catalog_supplier.CatalogSupp: Exact complete distinct supplier count across ALL of this donor's donations and gifts, computed before preview/paging. Displayed unique SupplierIds must match this count.
agent_donor_catalog_supplier.SupplierId: One distinct catalog supplier for this donor, across all Donation/Gift paths. Retrieve all rows for DonorId, not suppliers from a donation sample.
agent_donor_catalog_supplier.ResidentPre: Donor residence prefecture ID. Include with donor name and residence prefecture name before the complete supplier table.
agent_donor_catalog_supplier.SupplierPre: Supplier prefecture ID, separate from donor residence. Include with supplier name/type and SupplierPrefectureName.
